title: Headphones floating
prompt_en: 16:9 studio shot. Over-ear headphones float and rotate slowly in mid-air against a gradient background from deep blue to violet. Subtle particles drift; soft key light from above; camera slowly orbits.
prompt_zh: 16:9 摄影棚镜头。头戴式耳机悬浮在空中缓慢旋转，背景从深蓝渐变到紫色。微粒轻轻漂浮，上方柔和主光，镜头缓慢环绕。
why_it_works: Floating product plus gentle orbit is a classic tech-ad look and avoids hands and complex interactions.
result_check: Headband and ear cups stay attached
